snippet.title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Your only hope is each other.

Get your first look at gameplay from Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, a new mixed reality and VR adventure based on the world of Andy Weir’s Project Hail Mary.

Work alongside Rocky, diagnose failing systems, improvise scientific solutions and keep the mission alive in an original story that takes you on a journey across the stars.

Pre-order now on Meta Quest and PICO.

Coming to Meta Quest, PICO and Android XR.

#ProjectHailMary #VR #MixedReality #gamescom2026
